summary: Frontend E2E testing of Alee Club Talent App on mobile viewport (390x844). Verified the full participant + admin journey on the public preview URL. 13/14 flows from the request work end-to-end: Welcome → admin login → admin dashboard (revenue, stats, funnel, quick actions) → manage events (4 seeded visible, +/edit/delete chrome present) → manage applications (all status filter chips render) → admin logout → participant register → home (greeting + hero + categories + cards) → events tab (search + chips + cards + tap → detail) → event detail with Apply Now → apply multi-step form (steps 1, 2 validated; step 3 photo upload not testable from headless web - see notes) → payment screen with Razorpay/MOCKED + completes via mock → dashboard My Applications shows card with progress → application detail with timeline → profile + AI score (Claude responded, returned 0/100 with honest reasoning for empty profile) → admin updates status to shortlisted with feedback → participant verifies SHORTLISTED status, timeline updates, certificate unlocks (view-cert button appears).

issues: Console: 'shadow*' style props deprecated — switch to boxShadow (non-blocking)
Console: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' — move to style.pointerEvents (non-blocking)

AI returned valid response but score is 0/100 because profile is empty after registration. This is correct AI behavior, but UX could pre-fill more onboarding details OR show a friendlier 'Complete your profile to be scored' state instead of a literal 0.

action_items: Portfolio photo upload step in /apply/[id] uses expo-image-picker which on web depends on a hidden file input. Could not be exercised from headless Playwright. Recommend verifying on Expo Go (mobile) and/or wiring a fallback web file input with testID='web-photo-file' so future automated tests can attach a file. Test bypassed this step by creating the application via API which subsequently rendered payment, dashboard, detail and admin update flows correctly.
Consider showing a friendly empty state on Profile AI score when user just registered (currently shows '0/100' which can look like a bug even though AI feedback is correct).
Address React Native web deprecation warnings (pointerEvents prop, shadow* props) before going to production.

Razorpay is correctly MOCKED — payment screen shows 'Razorpay Secure', proceed-pay→complete-pay flow auto-marks paid via /api/payments/verify with mock:true. When real keys are added, ensure server ignores client-supplied mock flag (already handled per iteration_1 review).
critical_code_review_comments: All interactive elements use proper testID attributes (excellent test coverage support).
Email lowercased on register / login is consistent server side and frontend trims input — works correctly.
Auth token stored in localStorage on web (AsyncStorage.setItem('token', ...)) — fine for SPA, but consider httpOnly cookies for production hardening (per playbook).
Apply form validates fields step-by-step (Alert.alert) — good UX. However step 2 only checks bio (not achievements), step 3 hard-requires 1 photo (correct).
Payment screen idempotently handles already-paid state (shows 'Payment complete' + 'View Application') — robust.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows (13/13 UI flows passed; 1 step — portfolio photo upload — non-testable from headless web)

seed_data_creation: Registered participant e2e+1777882965@test.com / Test@1234 via UI; created application 34bc0c55-ca4d-4ad6-b0ee-5e5d2359f78e for event 'Miss Teen India 2026' via API (workaround for web ImagePicker); admin updated it to 'shortlisted' with feedback. No production data modified.

Test participant created during this run: e2e+1777882965@test.com / Test@1234 (has 1 shortlisted application id 34bc0c55-ca4d-4ad6-b0ee-5e5d2359f78e). To exercise the portfolio upload step end-to-end on web you must either (a) test on Expo Go mobile with ImagePicker, or (b) add a hidden <input type='file' testID='web-photo-file'/> fallback so set_input_files can attach a base64. AsyncStorage on web maps to localStorage key 'token'. The /payment/[id] screen will short-circuit to 'Payment complete' if status is already 'paid' — for fresh tests, create a fresh application first.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no blocking issues. AI score = 0 is correct (profile empty); only minor UX improvement and deprecation cleanups recommended.
